en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small rural village set in rolling hills. In the foreground is a steep grassy slope with a fenced path leading down to a chalet-style house with a steep tiled roof and timber framing. Below runs a narrow river or stream with a curved pedestrian path alongside it, and a small multi‑arch stone bridge crosses the water. In the middle ground are several traditional farmhouses and village buildings surrounded by trees. In the background, gently undulating farmland with scattered barns and a few houses stretches toward the horizon. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
